from pathlib import Path
programs=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792545201/attempts/077c639e3ede471faa305f8b7291dc1f/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    from collections import Counter
    background = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        for c in range(1, len(row) - 1):
            if row[c] == background and row[c - 1] == row[c + 1] and row[c - 1] != background:
                out[r][c] = 2
    return out
'''
path=programs/'task-c16c9305.py'
path.write_text(source)
